name: Pelloche
storyline:
Every card in Pelloche is a real piece of cinema, ranked against the rest of the catalogue: a film, a director, a composer, an actor or an actress. Rarity follows that ranking, so a card's scarcity says something about the work behind it.

Packs arrive on a timer or are bought with Pop's, the in-game currency earned by selling copies and completing objectives. Each card can turn up in five finishes (normal, reverse, holo, full art, full holo), and the rarity of a copy is fixed the moment it is drawn. A re-ranking of the catalogue never devalues what is already in a collection.

Sets are derived from the catalogue itself: every film by a director, every score by a composer, a decade, a genre, a studio, an award. Unique cards (1/1) are claimed atomically. Once one is gone, it never returns to the pool, and the Hall lists who holds each of them.

The game is free, needs no installation, and runs in any modern browser.
summary:
Pelloche is a cinema trading-card game played in the browser.

Open packs drawn from a ranked catalogue of films, directors, composers, actors and actresses, build a collection across five rarities and five finishes, chase the 1/1 uniques that can only ever be claimed once, complete sets, and trade with other players.

Packs refill on a timer, and every draw is resolved server-side.
